🔸 Kraken to offer 24/7 tokenized Apple $AAPL, Tesla $TSLA, Nvidia $NVDA shares to overseas clients via Solana $SOLUSD.
🔸 Wormhole integrated Dogecoin $DOGEUSD onto Solana $SOLUSD, enabling DOGE use in Solana DeFi and gaming.

🔸 BNB Chain $BNB's Maxwell hard fork (June 30) will halve block times; DEX daily volume hits $13.31B.
🔸 21Shares files for spot Dogecoin $DOGEUSD ETF, signaling institutional interest in DOGE.

🔸 Tesla $TSLA to launch robotaxi service in Austin on June 12.
🔸 21Shares files for spot Dogecoin ETF; Pakistan to establish government Bitcoin $BTCUSD reserve and begin mining.

...and that's the update for today. 🏁
🔸 Bitcoin $BTCUSD rebounded to $108,000 after volatility linked to Trump-Musk dispute; altcoins Dogecoin $DOGEUSD, Solana $SOLUSD, Ripple $XRPUSD, and $TRUMP $TRUMPUSD underperformed.

🔸 Stablecoin market cap hit a record $228B, up 17% YTD, with expanding real-world usage.
🔸 HYPE token surged to $44.69, overtaking Dogecoin in futures open interest.
🔸 Solana $SOLUSD DApps captured 58% of crypto app revenue for eight months; SOL traded at $158.

🔸 Meta Pool exploited for $27M via mpETH minting; Ethereum $ETHUSD remains top target for DeFi attacks.
🔸 SEC delays decisions on spot Dogecoin, Avalanche, XRP, and Solana $SOLUSD ETFs; sets July 22 deadline for XRP.

🔸 Kraken introduces native Bitcoin $BTCUSD staking via Babylon, offering up to 1% APR in BABY tokens, no wrapping required.
🔸 Hyperliquid’s HYPE token surpasses Dogecoin $DOGEUSD in futures open interest; Tron overtakes Dogecoin in market cap.

🔸 Bloomberg analysts raise odds of spot Solana, Litecoin, and XRP ETF approvals to 95%; Dogecoin, Cardano, Polkadot, Hedera, Avalanche at 90%.
🔸 OKX launches xBTC, a Bitcoin-backed asset, on Solana $SOLUSD; $250K+ in liquidity rewards from Kamino Finance and Orca.
